arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

tests = [
    ('a {:f} b', 'a .31415 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 5. b'),
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    print(f'String: {s!r:20s} -> {r}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
